Project.name: GT7 Companion
Project.annotation: Flutter app for real-time GT7 telemetry display across mobile and desktop platforms
Project.keywords: gt7, telemetry, flutter, dart, racing, udp, salsa20, motorsport

Actors.actor-Driver: Player actively racing in Gran Turismo 7, needs real-time telemetry on a secondary device.
Actors.actor-Spectator: Observer watching a race session, reviewing telemetry data post-race.

UC-001.Action: Receives and decrypts real-time UDP telemetry from PS5/GT7
UC-001.Goal: To monitor speed, RPM, tire data, fuel, and gear status live during a race
UC-001.Preconditions: PS5 running GT7 on the same local network; telemetry output enabled in GT7 settings
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: Telemetry data updates at game framerate with correct Salsa20 decryption; all gauges reflect live values

UC-002.Action: Views analog gauges for speed and RPM with dynamic color transitions
UC-002.Goal: To get at-a-glance performance feedback without looking away from the road
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Gauges animate smoothly; color transitions (green-yellow-red) reflect RPM range; fuel indicator shows inside speedometer

UC-003.Action: Monitors tire temperatures and pressures for all four wheels
UC-003.Goal: To optimize tire strategy and detect degradation early
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: Tire metrics (FL/FR/RL/RR) display temperature and pressure with responsive layout for desktop and mobile

UC-004.Action: Views daily race schedule and sport mode information
UC-004.Goal: To plan racing sessions and check upcoming events
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: Daily races load from API; race details (track, car class, schedule) display correctly

UC-005.Action: Views throttle/brake input graph over time
UC-005.Goal: To analyze driving inputs and improve lap consistency
UC-005.AcceptanceCriteria: Throttle and brake graph renders in real-time with 10-second ring buffer; CustomPaint used for performance

NonGoals.item-1: No multiplayer telemetry sharing in v1.
NonGoals.item-2: No lap time recording or historical analysis.
NonGoals.item-3: No integration with external sim racing platforms.

Constraints.constraint-1: Must work on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web from a single Dart codebase.
Constraints.constraint-2: Telemetry decryption must handle Salsa20 stream cipher in real-time without frame drops.
Constraints.constraint-3: UI must remain responsive at 60fps during active telemetry ingestion.
Constraints.constraint-4: Cross-platform code stays in Dart; no platform-specific native logic unless explicitly needed.

Risks.risk-1: UDP packet loss or decryption errors could cause gauge stuttering or incorrect values.
Risks.risk-2: High-frequency telemetry updates may cause excessive widget rebuilds if not properly throttled.
Risks.risk-3: GT7 telemetry protocol changes in game updates could break decryption.

OpenQuestions.question-1: Should telemetry data be persisted for post-session analysis?
